name: Caribou
long_description:
Caribou is transfer pricing software with the experts built in, for multi-entity companies expanding across borders, usually 2 to 10 entities with a UK or US parent and subsidiaries abroad. Software does the work and our tax experts own the outcome: we design the group's transfer pricing, draft the intercompany agreements, benchmark the pricing, post the accounting entries, and write the Local and Master Files and  then keep it all current as the group grows.

We also look across VAT, permanent establishment, withholding tax and R&D eligibility, and we've launched UK R&D tax relief claims. One team and one subscription, with questions during the year included instead of a Big Four project every couple of years. Butternut Box, Duffel, Hadrian, OpenFX, Solve Intelligence, Vertice, Omnea, and Encord work with us.
one_liner: Transfer pricing software with the experts built in
